scope: Machine execution timestamps and stored ETA scenarios only. No answer reading, behavioral rating, new inference, or scientific configuration changes.

start_definition.primary: Earliest observed actual preflight receipt in this run; includes local run preparation and elapsed gaps. Does not include earlier downloads, environment preparation, design, or future retrieval/review.
start_definition.secondary: Original formal collection queue start preserved by both queue-before-parallel and first queue-history. The final queue receipt start is an offline export recovery restart, not an experiment start.

machine_complete.human_blind_review: pending; not part of machine completion or ETA

sequential_queue_phases.name: initial_preparation_and_gaps
sequential_queue_phases.note: Includes preflight, clean collections, bridge/mapping, decode checks and intervening elapsed gaps. Model downloads and design before the first receipt are outside this span.

sequential_queue_phases.name: source_192_confirmation
sequential_queue_phases.note: Original two source workers preserved across scheduler replacement; no source restart.

export_recovery.recorded_reason: Pinned cached datasets retried network access; resumed export with offline environment. All inference reused; original frozen code unchanged.
export_recovery.note: This measures elapsed stalled attempt, not pure CPU service time. The archived attempt receipt correctly remains historical running; stop is evidenced by recovery receipt.

eta_audit.error_sign: predicted finish minus actual finish: positive means a later/conservative estimate; negative means completion occurred later than predicted.
eta_audit.actual_endpoint: target9b export receipt for 9B; final queue receipt for queue forecasts; queue target2b-confirmation end for toy forecasts

Not a confidence interval or guaranteed upper bound. Unmeasured arms use full token budgets and per-worker probe speed with configured worker count; measured arms use condition/task means. 2B initially inherits 9B concurrent speed. Unmeasured 2B setup, parallel validation and export use explicit rough allowances, not timed guarantees. Excludes human ratings and future failures.
2B just started; full token budgets at 9B concurrent probe speed; not a guarantee; excludes human blind review

2B behavior per-condition observed means (at least two samples per condition per worker); unseen diagnostics fixed allowances; unseen benchmark full token budgets at measured 2B three-process probe speed. Comparison uses earlier 9B speed. Rough 120s export allowance; excludes independent human review. Scenarios, not confidence bounds.

2B behavior per-condition observed means (at least two samples per condition per worker); unseen diagnostics fixed allowances; unseen benchmark full token budgets at measured 2B three-process probe speed. Comparison uses earlier 9B speed. Rough 120s export allowance; excludes independent human review. Scenarios, not confidence bounds.

2B observed behavior and diagnostic condition means, with fixed allowances for as-yet-unmeasured diagnostic conditions; unseen benchmark uses full token budgets at measured 2B three-process probe speed and fixed choice-scoring allowances. Comparison uses earlier 9B probe speed. Rough 120s export allowance; excludes independent human review. Scenarios, not confidence bounds.

2B actual per-worker GSM8K and HumanEval pair times (>=4 pairs each); unfinished choices use frozen 0.8s/MMLU and 2.5s/ARC per-pair assumptions; slowest worker plus rough 120s export allowance. Excludes local evidence retrieval/report delivery and human ratings. Scenario, not a guaranteed upper bound.

limitations: All elapsed differences rounded to millisecond precision; original microsecond timestamp strings retained.
Sequential phase spans use scheduler acknowledgements; actual worker spans are separately reported and should not be summed with nested phases.
Wall-clock elapsed is not GPU kernel time, GPU-hours, or exclusive utilization. Concurrent optimization probes, idle time, I/O and queue waits remain included in elapsed spans.
Only the twelve stored monitoring entries are audited; unrecorded earlier verbal estimates, including the initial approximately 24-hour estimate, are not reconstructed.
Early estimates used full output-token caps and a 9B probe reference for unseen 2B stages; later 2B-probe estimates still used token caps rather than observed benchmark lengths.

The last 9B pre-export estimate was early because of an unanticipated export network stall. The last 2B estimate remained late; this is forecast error, not evidence that the scientific computation was shortened.
Final machine completion excludes local evidence retrieval, archive/Git delivery, independent human ratings and behavioral-transfer conclusions.
